item.title: SQL Server Estate Management at 25,000 Databases: The Operations Manual Nobody Wrote
item.description: SQL Server estate management at 25,000+ databases across 300+ Azure VMs, run by one senior DBA: the inventory, automation, patching, and monitoring operating model.

item.title: About
item.description:
Dustin Marzolf. Senior DBA, 13 years on SQL Server and Azure. Sole senior DBA operating an estate of 25,000+ databases across 300+ Azure VMs.

This blog documents what the job actually looks like at that scale while the standalone DBA role dwindles around it: the registry, the automation library, patch rings, monitoring economics, migration math, and the career case for reading “dwindling” as a rebrand with a raise attached.

Every post ships with runnable scripts and real fleet numbers, anonymized to ratios where employer details would leak.
